title: Grindstone legacy
description: Mod adds a grindstone with full functionality to 1.12.2
body:
This mod was created for people who play on old verison (1.12.2) but want to have grindstone.

I add it to this version. Grindstone is works same as in versions 1.14+.

![Gui of grindstone](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0ff48e93ed5db29829a5c4626ae524279a3815a5_0.webp)
